title: How to Customize Your Discord Profile
summary: Make your first impression count with a profile that represents you how YOU want to be seen. Learn how to edit and customize your profile to have it rep you the right way.
body:
Your Discord profile is one of the first things people see when someone wants to learn more about you. We bet even *you* have immediately clicked on someone’s profile when they join a server or Group DM for the first time. It’s just become an internet instinct at this point! 

Make that first impression count by setting up your profile to represent yourself how YOU want to be seen. Read on to learn how to edit and customize your profile to have it rep you the right way.
